activatingLocationRef.description: A value uniquely identifying the source of this token request, e.g. a physical POS in a store, a website, etc.

expiryDate.description: The date the token will expire. ISO 8601 date format without timezone: YYYY-MM-DD

bookingDate.description: Timestamp to be used to book the event in the ledger in ISO 8601 GMT date time format: YYYY-MM-DD"T"hh:mm:ss"Z"

activationTimestamp.description: Card token activation timestamp in ISO 8601 GMT date time format: YYYY-MM-DD"T"hh:mm:ss"Z", with optional 9 decimals of seconds

activationTimezone.description: TimeZone name, see IANA time zone database

test.description: If it is TRUE then “_TEST” suffix will be added to the account Code
